def f(inp):
    a=np.array(inp);H,W=a.shape
    r,c=a.nonzero()
    r0,r1,c0,c1=r.min(),r.max(),c.min(),c.max()
    cnt=dict(zip(*np.unique(a[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1],return_counts=True)))
    inner=min(cnt,key=cnt.get); outer=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=inner][0]
    o=a.copy();o[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]=outer
    # extend to previous extent? compare extents before/after
    return o,a

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    b=np.array(G[n+' input']); o=np.array(G[n+' output'])
    print(n,'in shape',b.shape,'out shape',o.shape)
    nz=b.nonzero(); r0,r1,c0,c1=nz[0].min(),nz[0].max(),nz[1].min(),nz[1].max()
    print('  bbox',r0,r1,c0,c1)
    onz=o.nonzero(); or0,or1,oc0,oc1=onz[0].min(),onz[0].max(),onz[1].min(),onz[1].max()
    print('  out bbox',or0,or1,oc0,oc1,'growth',(or0-r0,or1-r1,oc0-c0,oc1-c1))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter
T=np.array(G['Test input'])
nb=np.argwhere(T!=0)
r0,r1,c0,c1=int(nb[:,0].min()),int(nb[:,0].max()),int(nb[:,1].min()),int(nb[:,1].max())
sub=T[r0:r1+1,c0:c1]
bc=Counter(sub.ravel().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0]
ic=[k for k,v in Counter(sub.ravel().tolist()).items() if k!=bc][0]
# ring thickness = fill side
ff=np.argwhere(sub==ic); fs=int(ff[:,0].ptp())  # fill side
ring=fs
out=np.full((sub.shape[0]+2*ring,sub.shape[1]+2*ring),bc)
out[ring:-ring,ring:-ring]=sub
print('shape',out.shape,'ring',ring)
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
print(json.dumps(out.tolist()))

def analyze(n):

    idx=np.argwhere(s==ii)

    return (r0,c0), (sh,sw), (idx[:,0].min(),idx[:,0].max()+1,idx[:,1].min(),idx[:,1].max()+1), b.nonzero()[0].min(), b.nonzero()[1].min(), b.shape

import numpy as np
for n in range(1,6):
    a=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); b=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    na=a.nonzero()
    r0,r1=na[:,0].min(),na[:,0].max(); c0,c1=na[:,1].min(),na[:,1].max()
    cnt=collections.Counter(a[r0:r1+1,c0:c1].ravel())
    maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    minor=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=maj][0]
    h=r1-r0+1; t=(h-3)//2 if h>=4 else 1
    o=np.zeros_like(a)
    for i in range(a.shape[0]):
        for j in range(a.shape[1]):
            if r0-t<=i<=r1+t and c0-t<=j<=c1+t:
                o[i,j]=minor if (i<r0 or i>r1 or j<c0 or j>c1) else int(a[i,j])
    print(n, np.array_equal(o,b), 't=',t, 'bbox rows',r0,r1,'out bbox',b.nonzero()[:,0].min(),b.nonzero()[:,0].max())
